info.title: How to play
info.connections.heading: Connections
info.connections.body:
You get a grid of shuffled words. Your job is to sort them into equal-sized groups — every puzzle tells you how many groups and how many words each.

There is only one correct grouping. A word may look like it fits two categories, but that's the trap.

Pick the number of words shown by the Submit button. If wrong, try again. Depending on the puzzle, you'll have a fixed number of mistakes or unlimited tries. If you pick all-but-one correctly, the game will say "One away!".

Groups are color-coded from easiest to hardest.
